name: gizza-ai/jq-query
summary: Run a jq program against JSON.

tool.description: Run a jq program/filter against a JSON document and return the transformed output, using a pure-Rust jq implementation (jaq) with the jq standard library (map, select, group_by, etc.). A filter can produce zero, one, or many values — each is returned as a serialized JSON string in `outputs`. Set pretty=true to indent. Example query: '.items | map(.price) | add'.

json.description: The JSON document to run the filter against.

pretty.description: Pretty-print (indent) each JSON output. Default false (compact).
